// Fixture for rpcCastsOnDeclaredRpcs.test.ts — NOT compiled, NOT imported by
// the app. It reproduces the three cast shapes the 14 remaining call sites had
// before they were removed, plus the ONE that must stay green, so the guard is
// shown able to fail rather than asserted to work. `.ts.txt` for the same
// reason the raceClass fixtures use it: the repo's typecheck must not see it.

// 1. The inline `"name" as never` on a call whose args are then cast too.
export async function apply(supabase: any, jobId: string, message: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc("apply_to_job" as never, {
    p_job_id: jobId,
    p_message: message,
  } as never);
  return error;
}

// 2. The `.bind(supabase) as unknown as (...)` hand-written signature, whose
//    parentheses balance at `(supabase)` long before the RPC name appears.
export async function recordView(supabase: any, jobId: string) {
  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as (
    fn: "record_job_view",
    args: { p_job_id: string },
  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { code?: string } | null }>;
  await rpc("record_job_view", { p_job_id: jobId });
}

// 3. The generic wrapper that names no RPC, so every call routed through it is
//    invisible to a by-name scan.
export function callUntypedRpc<TArgs extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  supabase: any,
  fn: string,
  args: TArgs,
) {
  return (supabase.rpc as unknown as (
    fn: string,
    args: TArgs,
  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { code?: string } | null }>)(fn, args);
}

// 4. MUST STAY GREEN. A parameter that genuinely takes NULL, cast on that one
//    argument and justified.
export async function snooze(supabase: any, jobId: string, untilIso: string | null) {
  // nullable-arg: `set_thread_snooze(_until timestamptz)` (migration
  // 20260609150000) takes NULL as "mute forever"; a generated `Args` type
  // renders every parameter non-null, so it cannot express that.
  return supabase.rpc("set_thread_snooze", { _job_id: jobId, _until: untilIso as string });
}
